text:
anya.dev: Quick heads-up — vendor pushed an urgent switch-fabric microcode patch for the edge aggregation ASICs in az-west1-edge. They're asking for a staggered rack-level BMC + switch firmware restart. Proposed window: Tue 2026-03-30 01:00–04:00 UTC.

raj_ops: Do we have to reboot racks or can we do an in-service firmware apply?

mike_platform: vendor notes this revision requires ASIC re-init (soft-apply causes packet path instability). So plan is: staggered reboots, 1 rack every 12m, parallelism 1. Total ~15 racks. We'll cordon + drain pods, move latency-sensitive pools to reserved burst nodes, then reboot.

lina_prod: Customer impact: top 5 tenants use edge pools in that region. I'll draft targeted comms. Can we guarantee no >200ms p99 spike? Sales will want numbers.

anya.dev: No hard guarantees — expect short egress blips during interface flap. We will:
- pre-warm KV/prefix caches on backfill nodes
- route non-critical traffic to eu-central fallback for 30m bucket if needed
- run canary on 2 racks first

oncall_sre: I'll own on-call during the window. Please add me to the runbook steps. Also tag deploy-bot to create an incident thread when the first cordon starts.

mike_platform: Runbook snippet (will be in the maintenance doc):
```
# cordon + drain (example)
kubectl cordon node-abc123 -n production
kubectl drain node-abc123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
# verify KV cache seeding on backfill nodes (script)
./tools/seed_kv_cache --pool=edge-burst-001 --tags=prewarm
```

raj_ops: Cost/ops note — we estimate ~3 hours of burst capacity at ~6k USD/hr if we need to spin dedicated GPUs for routing-heavy tenants. If we can rely on prefix-cache seeding + small fallback, cost should be <2k USD/hr. Marking finance FYI.

lina_prod: I'll confirm which tenants get Dedicated failover and include projected cost ranges in the comms.

anya.dev: Canary plan: start 01:00 UTC -> reboot rack-01, monitor for 20m. If no packet-drop regressions and latency steady, continue 1 rack / 12m. If we see >0.5% dropped flows for >2 consecutive minutes, abort and failover remaining traffic to eu-central.

oncall_sre: Can we add a short trace sampling increase for 1h post-reboot? Want deeper visibility on KV miss rates.

mike_platform: Yes — increasing trace retention + KV miss alerting for that window. Will add a per-rack token-meter to track cost.

deploy-bot: [automated] maintenance-schedule created: maintenance/1755551234-edge-fabric-patch. First cordon scheduled at 1755554800.

raj_ops: One more ask — please coordinate with routing team to push a temporary egress ratecap rule to reduce rebuffer storms if a switch goes noisy.

anya.dev: noted. I'll sync with routing. Final checklist before we send comms tomorrow: canary checklist + cost estimate + runbook + on-call rotation. :white_check_mark:
